options.label: A
options.textMd: Batch Cedar and Batch Pine are tied

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Batch Cedar: 180/200=90%; Batch Elm: 200/250=80%; Batch Pine: 315/350=90%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 90%.

distractorRationale.d: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 90%, 80%, 90%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
